propositions: Production bugs resulted from store write paths bypassing canonical write seams using raw git commands (add/commit/rm) outside sanctioned APIs

Deterministic two-layer lint (Python AST + workflow/shell cwd-aware parsing) must flag raw git mutations by detecting subprocess calls or wrapper invocations with mutation verbs, resolved via intra-function variable tracking, with fail-closed opaque-argv handling

Sanction mechanism is a single inline mandatory-reason marker `# raw-git-ok: <reason>` (distinct from tickets-boundary-ok semantics) on the offending line or enclosing function; marker-without-reason fails enforcement
Report-mode bootstrap identifies all legitimate hits (seam internals, maintenance callers, disposable sandbox repos) for inline marking before enforcement is activated
Teaching message must direct authors to store write APIs (event_append, txn, reconciler git_adapter) rather than raw git or run_git_write alone
